notes.title: 2.2.0 Update
notes.content:
Hello Unlikely Heroes and Experts!
Dr TiNT is always looking out make Them Bombs impossi... erm... smooth and better.

Here is a list of this week's updates (version 2.2.0):
- We've added new, simplified ways of finding game partners to play with over voice chat. Check the button in the main menu.
- You can now enjoy the game and manual in Simplified Chinese. Thanks to our awesome fan deluxghost for providing the full translation!
- You can now enjoy the game and manual in Czech. Thanks to our awesome fans Martin Pihrt, Filip Starove for providing the full translation!
- You can now enjoy the game and manual in Turkish. Thanks to our awesome fan Alper TOPAL for providing the full translation!
- You can now enjoy the game and manual in Romanian. Thanks to our awesome fan Iacob Florin for providing the full translation!
- New newspaper article layout after disarming the bomb.
- Many small bug fixes.

We are currently holding the "Design Your Own Module" contest - check it out here: https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/806900/view/2198263022907335720

Keep disarming
Jan Mysior
Yellow Dot Games

notes.title: Design Your Module Contest
notes.content:
[h3]Put yourself in the shoes of the ingenious villain Dr TiNT and make the lives of the Unlikely Heroes more diffi… fun! Design your own bomb module  and become the author of one of the game's bomb modules![/h3]

[b]HOW TO ENTER[/b]
[list][*]     Download Them Bombs or Sure-Fire Bomb Defusal Manual from www.thembombs.com/manual
[*]     Read the Manual – check out the existing modules to make sure your module is different from the ones already in the game.
[*]     [b]Design your own, original bomb module[/b] – write a page from an instruction manual for disarming your module. The instructions must include the following sections: “Overview”, “To disarm”.
Optionally, the instructions may include “Tips for the ‘Still-Alive Bomb Defuser’” section, and if necessary, a sketch or a table.
The instructions should be prepared in English – Don’t worry if it’s not perfect, we’ll smooth out the rough edges if needed!
[*]     Send your project using the [url=https://thembombs.com/contest][b]ENTRY FORM[/b][/url]
[/list]


[b]TIMEFRAME[/b]
Contest start date: [b]21.04.2020[/b]
Contest end date: [b]20.05.2020[/b]


[b]PRIZES[/b]
The most interesting and original module will come to life by becoming the [b]new Them Bombs game module[/b]! Your project will get a professional graphic designer transformation, it will be programmed and tested. In addition, the author of the winning module will receive [b]an advanced Swiss Army knife[/b] – an indispensable tool for any real-life Unlikely Hero.

The authors of the 2nd and 3rd place will receive a [b]Swiss Army knife[/b] each.

notes.title: Reviews Roulette: The one with Donkey Kong's wooden nipples
notes.content:
Reviews Roulette is where the RPS video department attempt to review all the random game keys that arrive unsolicited in their inbox. The hunt for hidden gems begins!

Did you know Rock Paper Shotgun have an absolutely phenomenal, world-class video department? No? Well, you do now. And this knowledge comes from me, Alice L, one of the three members of said world-class video department, so you can guarantee that praise is true and unbiased in every way. Something we put together on an infrequent basis is Reviews Roulette. It’s infrequent because it’s no easy thing being a YouTuber. There are so many apology videos, rants, and call-out vids to do, it’s hard to schedule the fun things more regularly.

Reviews Roulette is where the RPS video team take a selection of random review keys we’ve been sent, play them for ten minutes, and decide if we want to play them for longer. If they really catch our eye, they’ll get the esteemed Daddy Wallace award. For context, please refer to this episode.

(more…)
